title: How to Prepare Before Hiring a Resume Writer
h1: How to prepare before hiring a resume writer
description: Prepare for a resume rewrite: target job, achievements, old documents, keywords, formatting rules, privacy, what a resume writer needs and what to ask.
intro: A resume writer can turn a long list of duties into a clear story of what you achieved. They can only work with what you give them, though, and the best results come when you arrive with a target job, real accomplishments and honest answers to their questions. This article explains how to prepare, what to share and what to ask before you hire someone to write or update your resume, cover letter or profile.

faq.q: Do I need to know my target job?
faq.a: It helps a lot. A resume aimed at a specific kind of role is far stronger than a general one.

faq.q: What should I send the writer?
faq.a: Your current resume, a few job postings you want, a list of achievements with numbers where possible and your career goals.
A good writer does not. Everything in the document must be true and something you can discuss in an interview.

faq.q: Should the resume pass automated screening?
faq.a: Many employers use software to read resumes, so a clean layout and clear headings usually work better than complex graphics.

faq.q: Do I need a cover letter and profile too?
faq.a: That depends on your field. Ask which documents are most useful for the roles you want.
